title: Memory and CPU profiling
description: Node.js 24 runtime lesson: A telemetry dashboard reports zeros for RSS, heap and CPU because the metrics are mocked rather than sampled from the actual Node process. Includes executable core-module fixtures, a failing starter and instructor regression suite.
objectives: Measure process.memoryUsage and process.cpuUsage and distinguish RSS from V8 heap-used before optimizing CPU-bound work.
Repair node-memory-cpu-metrics and prove a failure boundary.
Describe production risks not exercised by the local Node test.
rubric: I can explain the Node runtime contract for memory and cpu profiling.
I can reproduce and repair 10.01.06 with real Node core modules.
I can identify a security or load test needed before deployment.
